description: Ministry of Lands - Appointed Mr. M. B. H. M. Dayaratne as an acquiring officer for land acquisition duties around Dedduwa Canal
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an officer for land acquisition duties related to the Dedduwa Canal under the Land Acquisition Act. The core content focuses on property acquisition procedures and the appointment is made specifically for land-related duties, making this a clear case of Land Gazette classification (Type 4) rather than a government personnel appointment gazette.
